## Raw second transcription

```yaml
```yaml
lines:
  - id: dependent.one
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One (this person, for counting)"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: param, ref: dependent.one}

  - id: dependent.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}

  - id: dependent.h_rel_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Son, daughter, stepchild, foster child, brother, sister, stepbrother, stepsister, half brother, half sister, or a descendant of any of them"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling_descendant"}]}

  - id: dependent.h_age_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Under age 19 at the end of 2025 and younger than you (or your spouse if filing jointly), or under age 24, a full-time student and younger than you, or any age and permanently and totally disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.age_limit}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.younger, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.student_age_limit}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.student, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.younger, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.disabled, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_resident
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lived with you for more than half of 2025"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1: the person meets the conditions to be your qualifying child"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_age_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.self_support, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_resident, {const: true}]}
    note: "Open: the tiebreaker rules for a qualifying child of more than one person need parentage and AGI facts not in the inputs, and the kidnapped-child residency treatment (Pub. 501) needs facts about the parts of the years before the kidnapping and after the return that are not supplied. Chosen: the filer is treated as the one entitled to claim the child (other_claimant is used only in the qualifying relative test), and residency is the months input alone; dependent.kidnapped is not used."

  - id: dependent.h_rel_listed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Relatives who don't have to live with you (related to you, or to your spouse on a joint return)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent_relative"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "in_law"}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.spouse_relative, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_rel_household
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Any other person (other than your spouse) who lived with you all year as a member of your household if your relationship didn't violate local law"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.qr_all_year, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.lawful, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_rel_qr
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Member of household or relationship test"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_listed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_household, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qc_of_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The person is a qualifying child of another taxpayer for 2025"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_claimant, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_nontaxpayer, {const: false}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qr
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4: the person meets the conditions to be your qualifying relative"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc_of_other, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qr, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.gross_income, {param: qr.gross_income_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.supported, {const: true}]}
    note: "The sheltered-workshop exception to the gross income test is not encoded; the gross income input is used as given."

  - id: dependent.h_citizen_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. resident alien, or a resident of Canada or Mexico"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.canada_mexico, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_can_claim_any
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You are filing a joint return, or you could not be claimed as a dependent on someone else's 2025 tax return"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    note: "sa.dependent also covers dual-status aliens; it is used as the Step 2 question 4 / Step 4 question 5 answer."

  - id: dependent.claimed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim this person as a dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_citizen_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_can_claim_any, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.divorced_rule, dependent.multiple_support]
    note: "Married person: a married person who files a joint return (not only for a refund) can't be claimed; otherwise marriage does not block the claim, so the joint_return input is used rather than refusing on dependent.married."

  - id: dependent.h_under17
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Under age 17 at the end of 2025"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: ctc.age_limit}]}

  - id: dependent.ctc_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim the child tax credit for this person"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_under17, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.work_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.ctc_ssn, {const: true}]}
    note: "household.ctc_ssn is read as the filer requirement (you, or one spouse on a joint return, with an SSN valid for employment and the other spouse with an SSN or ITIN)."

  - id: dependent.odc_person
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim the credit for other dependents for this person"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_tin, {const: true}]}
    note: "household.all_tin is read as Step 5 question 1 (you, and your spouse if filing jointly, have an SSN or ITIN issued, or applied for, by the due date)."

  - id: dependent.h_ctc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,200 per qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ctc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.h_odc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$500 per other dependent"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: odc.per_dependent}

  - id: dependent.h_actc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$1,700 per qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: actc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.ctc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's share of Schedule 8812 line 5 (line 4 times $2,200)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_ctc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.odc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's share of Schedule 8812 line 7 (line 6 times $500)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_odc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.actc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's share of Schedule 8812 line 16b (qualifying children times $1,700)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_actc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Test 1: your parent whom you can claim as a dependent, whose main home for all of 2025 you paid over half the cost of keeping up"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.parent_home_paid, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Test 2: a person who lived in your home for more than half of the year and is your dependent (not only because the person lived with you all year), or your qualifying child who isn't your dependent and is unmarried or isn't your dependent only because you can be claimed as a dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_resident, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
                - op: test
                  any:
                    - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
                    - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_listed, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: false}]}
                - op: test
                  any:
                    - {op: test, eq: [dependent.married, {const: false}]}
                    - op: test
                      all:
                        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_citizen_ok, {const: true}]}
                        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_can_claim_any, {const: false}]}
    note: "Exclusions (a) divorced/separated parents' rule, (c) multiple support agreement and item 4 (custodial parent) are refused through dependent.claimed. The kidnapped-child exception to time lived with you is not encoded."

  - id: dependent.hoh_absence
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A head of household qualifying person under Test 2 whose time lived with you counts an absence from which return was not reasonably expected or during which you did not keep up the home"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.hoh_test2, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.absence_no_return, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.eic_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying child for the EIC"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_age_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.us_half, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.married, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.divorced_rule]
    note: "Married child: qualifying only if you can claim the child as your dependent. The tiebreaker rules and the kidnapped-child exception are not encoded (see dependent.h_qc)."

  - id: dependent.eic_ssn_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying child for the EIC who has a valid SSN"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_dc_under13
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Under age 13 when (some of) the care was provided"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_under13, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.dc_qp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying person: a qualifying child under age 13 whom you can claim as a dependent, or a dependent who wasn't physically or mentally able to care for themselves and lived with you for more than half the year"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_resident, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_dc_under13, {const: true}]}
    note: "A disabled person who would be your dependent but for gross income, a joint return or your being claimable, and a custodial parent's nondependent child, are the f2441.nondependent screen; only claimed dependents are qualifying persons here."

  - id: dependent.h_cent
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One cent"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: sc.one_cent}

  - id: dependent.h_dc_unit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One cent if a qualifying person, otherwise zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_cent}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.dc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying persons this entry adds (1 or 0)"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: percent_floor, part: dependent.h_dc_unit, whole: {const: 100}, cap: 100}
    note: "No atom selects a Count conditionally; 100 x (1 cent or 0) / 100 cents gives exactly 1 or 0."

  - id: dependent.dc_line2d
    printed: "2(d)"
    label: "Qualified expenses you incurred and paid in 2025 for the person listed in column (a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.dc_paid}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp
    note: "Benefits on line 28 are not removed here; per the dc_paid input, Form 2441 line 30/31 accounts for excluded benefits."

  - id: dependent.dc_line2c
    printed: "2(c)"
    label: "Check here if the qualifying person was over age 12 and was disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, gt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_over12_care, {const: true}]}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp

  - id: dependent.h_ptc_counts
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A dependent required to file an income tax return because their income meets the filing threshold"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ptc_files, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.ptc_magi_counted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This dependent's modified AGI included on Worksheet 1-2 (Form 8962, line 2b)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_ptc_counts, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.ptc_magi}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_ptc_counts, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_student
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Student for whom you can claim an education credit (your dependent, expenses paid, Form 1098-T requirement met, TIN issued by the due date)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_1098t, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_tin_issued, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_aoc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Complete lines 27 through 30 for this student (American opportunity credit)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line23, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line24, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line25, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line26, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_ein, {const: true}]}
    note: "Without the institution's EIN the American opportunity credit can't be claimed; the student is routed to line 31 (lifetime learning credit), which needs no EIN."

  - id: dependent.h_llc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Go to line 31 for this student (lifetime learning credit)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_aoc, {const: false}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_adj
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Total adjustments (tax-free educational assistance received in 2025 and in 2026, and refunds)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_a2025, dependent.edu_a2026, dependent.edu_refunds]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_over_refused
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjustments for an academic period exceed that period's expenses (per-period worksheet needed)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [dependent.h_edu_adj, {const: 0}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_over, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_total
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualified education expenses for the American opportunity credit (tuition, required fees and course materials)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_inst, dependent.edu_mat]}

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_aqee
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses. Subtract line 3 from line 1. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.h_aoc_total, take: dependent.h_edu_adj}

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_cap
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.expense_cap}

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_capped
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses, not more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [dependent.h_aoc_aqee, dependent.h_aoc_cap]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line27
    printed: "27"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Don't enter more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_aoc, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_aoc_capped}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_aoc, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_band
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.full_band}

  - id: dependent.edu_line28
    printed: "28"
    label: "Subtract $2,000 from line 27. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_line27, take: dependent.h_aoc_band}
    shown_when: dependent.h_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line29
    printed: "29"
    label: "Multiply line 28 by 25% (0.25)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: multiply_rate, amount: dependent.edu_line28, rate: {param: aoc.second_rate}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_line28_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 28 is zero"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}

  - id: dependent.h_line29_plus
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Add $2,000 to the amount on line 29"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_line29, dependent.h_aoc_band]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line30
    printed: "30"
    label: "If line 28 is zero, enter the amount from line 27. Otherwise, add $2,000 to the amount on line 29 and enter the result"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_line28_zero, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.edu_line27}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_line28_zero, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_line29_plus}
    shown_when: dependent.h_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_llc_aqee
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses for the lifetime learning credit (tuition and required fees, less adjustments; if zero or less, -0-)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_inst, take: dependent.h_edu_adj}

  - id: dependent.edu_line31
    printed: "31"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Include the total of all amounts from all Parts III, line 31, on Part II, line 10"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_llc, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_llc_aqee}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_llc, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_llc
```
